purpose: Preserve workflow review safety while allowing fan-out-neutral controllers to be added and maintained without reintroducing pull_request fan-out: self-waking workflows keep their existing proof path, reduced workflows retain exact central action-pin/domain proof, and workflows without direct pull_request validation may pass only through an explicit changed deterministic proof file that is executed by this guard.
laws: If a changed workflow still wakes on its own definition file, its existing verifier remains the proof path.
If a changed workflow no longer self-wakes, a pin-only update is allowed only when its added exact action spec is present in and therefore exercised by the candidate central Control Plane workflow.
Action-family membership alone is never sufficient proof for a reduced workflow; an unexercised exact pin fails closed.
Removing only the workflow's own path entry from pull_request.paths is allowed only when the workflow keeps pull_request enabled and retains at least one non-workflow domain path.
Any other existing workflow with pull_request enabled that does not self-wake must be paired with a changed non-workflow path that wakes the current workflow verifier.

A newly added workflow may avoid pull_request fan-out only when it declares exactly one holding-workflow-definition-proof path under an allowed prefix, that proof file is changed in the same candidate, references the workflow path, and executes successfully during the guard.

An existing workflow with no direct pull_request trigger may be maintained through the same paired deterministic proof contract; the proof file must change with the workflow and execute successfully in the candidate Control Plane run.
A paired workflow-definition proof never grants runtime authority; it only proves candidate workflow semantics during review.
Deleted workflow definitions without a bounded maintenance review fail closed.
Unknown diff semantics, missing proof bytes, unchanged proof files, unapproved proof locations or failed proof execution fail closed.
